Defensive security (hardening, records/forensics, vulns, scans, AppArmor) NOT this skill: handled by sister local-security skill. Use when asked: auditing a Linux system, health-check, OS health status, routine review, cleaning packages/caches/logs, orphan pacman/AUR, boot or resource optimization, or periodic maintenance of Arch/EndeavourOS/CachyOS/Debian/RHEL. Includes guided interaction to select objective, mode and depth according to context. Not for defensive security hardening or forensics (→ local-security). Uses Bash/Write for host mutations only via run_registered.

Use when the operator requests system security audit, host hardening or auth log review. Not for application code vulnerabilities (→ web-owasp) nor disk cleanup (→ local-maintenance). Uses Bash/Write for host hardening only via run_registered.
